title: DiffDA-Net benchmark analog circuit fault diagnosis datasets
abstract: This dataset provides time-domain fault responses for two widely used benchmark analog circuits — the Sallen-Key bandpass filter and the four-opamp biquad high-pass filter — simulated with PSpice Monte Carlo analysis. The data support research on data-driven analog-circuit fault diagnosis, and in particular on class-imbalanced and cross-severity (variable-operating-condition) settings.For each circuit, two fault-severity levels are provided: 50% parametric deviation (established faults) and 25% parametric deviation (early-stage / incipient faults). Resistor tolerance is 5% and capacitor tolerance is 10%. The excitation is a single pulse with amplitude 5 V and duration 10 microseconds. Each fault mode is simulated with 2000 Monte Carlo runs.Files included (four comma-separated plain-text files):- sally_50_150.txt — Sallen-Key BPF, 50% deviation, 9 classes, 18,000 rows x 150 columns (~66 MB)- sally_25_150.txt — Sallen-Key BPF, 25% deviation, 9 classes, 18,000 rows x 150 columns (~67 MB)- four_opamp_50_300.txt — Four-opamp biquad HPF, 50% deviation, 13 classes, 26,000 rows x 300 columns (~190 MB)- four_opamp_25_300.txt — Four-opamp biquad HPF, 25% deviation, 13 classes, 26,000 rows x 300 columns (~190 MB)Each row is one sample; values are in scientific notation and separated by commas. Fault classes are stored sequentially: rows 1–2000 = class 0 (No Fault), rows 2001–4000 = class 1, and so on. Sampling interval is 0.5 microseconds (Sallen-Key) and 1 microsecond (four-opamp).Class definitions:- Sallen-Key: 9 classes = 1 No Fault + 8 parametric faults (C1, C2, R2, R3 each with +/- deviation)- Four-opamp: 13 classes = 1 No Fault + 12 parametric faults (C1, C2, R1, R2, R3, R4 each with +/- deviation)These datasets accompany the paper "DiffDA-Net: Diffusion-Augmented Domain Adaptive Network for Analog Circuit Fault Diagnosis under Imbalanced and Variable Operating Conditions" (Zhang, Yang and Han, 2026; submitted to Scientific Reports). The companion source code and pre-trained diffusion weights are available as a separate figshare item (see Related items).License: This project is released for academic use only. For commercial use, please contact the corresponding author.
